en.name: Panettone
en.summary: Sealed in its cellophane bag, a panettone keeps 3–6 months from purchase in a cool dark cupboard — those long printed dates are real. Once you open the bag the clock changes completely: 3–5 days. Frozen, 6–12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). Do not refrigerate it.
en.pantry: Sealed, somewhere cool and dark, 3–6 months from purchase and to the printed date. This is not preservatives. A proper panettone is leavened with a stiff sourdough, carries a great deal of butter, egg yolk and sugar, and is baked to a low residual moisture: the sugar and fat bind and displace the water that mould and bacteria would otherwise need, and the acidity of the levain does the rest. Opened, reckon on 3–5 days, because the very open, shredded crumb dries out fast — press the cut face against the bag, fold it closed, and finish it within the week. Stale panettone is the point of French toast and of the Milanese habit of dunking it; it is not a failure state. These figures are borrowed from the published ones for fruit cake, the closest long-keeping festive bake, and trimmed because panettone is moister.
en.fridge: Don't. Refrigeration accelerates staling — starch retrogradation runs fastest just above freezing — and this is a bread, whatever the tin it came in suggests. The fridge would only be tempting in a hot humid kitchen where mould could win, and in that case the freezer is the right answer instead, because it stops mould without hardening the crumb. No refrigerated timeline is given here for exactly that reason.
en.freezer: 6–12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, whole in its bag or in wedges wrapped tight. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well past that; the limit is drying, ice crystals and freezer burn. This is the sensible move for half a panettone in January, or for a hot humid kitchen. Thaw it at room temperature in the wrapping and warm it briefly before serving — a little heat brings the butter back and the aroma with it.
en.thawing: Thaw wrapped at room temperature, then warm briefly in a low oven. A wedge thawed in the fridge and still cold may be refrozen with some quality loss; one thawed on a warm counter should not be refrozen.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould spots, most likely on a cut face or in a bag that was resealed damp.
A rancid or crayon-like smell from the butter in an old cake.
A crumb that has dried to crumbs and no longer pulls into strands.
A sharply alcoholic or vinegary smell, beyond the normal sourdough tang.
tips: Keep it sealed in the bag it came in until you cut it.
Cut from the middle and press the halves back together, cut faces touching.
Freeze half on the day you open it rather than losing it to the week.
Panettone already sliced and sold loose has a much shorter life than a sealed whole one.

faq.a: 3–6 months from purchase sealed in its bag in a cool dark cupboard. Once opened, 3–5 days.
Yes, 6–12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F), whole or in wedges. Thaw at room temperature and warm briefly before serving.

faq.q: Should panettone go in the fridge?
faq.a: No. It is a bread, and refrigeration accelerates staling. If your kitchen is hot and humid, freeze it instead.

zh.name: 義大利聖誕麵包
zh.summary: 封在玻璃紙袋裡、放陰涼避光處，自購買日起可放 3～6 個月——包裝上那些長得不像話的日期是真的。一旦拆封，時鐘就完全換了一個：3～5 天。冷凍的話，−18 °C 下自購買日起 6～12 個月。不要冷藏。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼避光，自購買日起 3～6 個月，並以印製日期為準。這不是靠防腐劑。正統的潘娜朵尼用硬種酸種麵團發酵，含有大量奶油、蛋黃和糖，而且烤到殘留水分很低：糖和油脂把霉菌與細菌需要的水分綁住、擠掉，剩下的交給酸種本身的酸度。拆封之後請抓 3～5 天，因為它那種極度開放、拉絲狀的組織乾得很快——把切面壓回袋子上、折起來封好，一週內吃完。放到有點乾的潘娜朵尼正是法式吐司的材料，也正是米蘭人拿它沾著吃的理由，那不是壞掉。這些數字是比照水果蛋糕（資料裡最接近的耐放節慶烘焙品）而來，並因為潘娜朵尼更濕潤而往下修過。
zh.fridge: 不要。冷藏會加速老化——澱粉回凝在略高於冰點時最快——而不管它裝在多漂亮的鐵盒裡，它本質上是麵包。只有在又熱又濕、霉可能先贏的廚房裡才會想冰它，而那種情況下正確答案是冷凍，因為冷凍擋得住霉又不會把組織弄硬。這裡沒有給冷藏期限，原因正是如此。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 6～12 個月品質最好，整顆連袋冷凍或切片包緊都可以。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；限制它的是變乾、冰晶和凍燒。一月還剩半顆的時候，或是廚房又熱又濕的時候，這就是聰明的做法。要吃時包著在室溫解凍，上桌前稍微加熱——一點熱會讓奶油回來，香氣也跟著回來。
zh.thawing: 包著在室溫解凍，再用低溫烤箱稍微回溫。在冷藏解凍、還是冰的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；在溫暖檯面上解凍過的就不要再凍回去。
spoilage: 長出絨毛狀霉點，最可能在切面上，或在受潮又封回去的袋子裡。
聞得到奶油油耗味、像蠟筆的氣味。
組織乾到變成碎屑，完全拉不出絲。
出現刺鼻的酒精味或醋酸味，超出正常酸種的那點微酸。
tips: 沒有要切之前，就讓它一直待在原本的密封袋裡。
從中間切開，吃完把兩半的切面對貼壓回去。
拆封那天就先冷凍一半，好過整個星期慢慢看它乾掉。
已經切片散賣的潘娜朵尼，壽命比密封整顆短得多。

faq.q: 義大利聖誕麵包可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封在袋子裡、放陰涼避光處，自購買日起 3～6 個月。拆封之後是 3～5 天。
可以，−18 °C 下自購買日起 6～12 個月，整顆或切片都行。室溫解凍，上桌前稍微加熱。

faq.q: 潘娜朵尼要放冰箱冷藏嗎？
faq.a: 不要。它是麵包，冷藏會加速老化。如果廚房又熱又濕，請改用冷凍。
